water_resistance_min_m.description: Minimum water resistance in metres (50 for showering, 100 for swimming).

function.name: get_product_details

product_id.description: A product ID (SKU) such as '1001SL01', or a style ID such as 'V1001'.

function.name: compare_products

function.name: check_inventory

product_id.description: SKU or style ID.

colour.description: Optional dial or strap colour, used to pick the right variant when a style ID is given.

store_id.description: Store to check. Defaults to this store.

function.name: get_alternatives

function.name: call_staff

function.name: get_product_details

product_id.description: A product ID (SKU) such as '1001SL01', or a style ID such as 'V1001'.

function.name: compare_products

attributes.description: Optional list of attributes to compare, e.g. ['mrp', 'water_resistance_m']. Omit to compare all key attributes.

function.name: check_inventory

query.description: Optional keywords for anything the filters don't cover: a collection or model name, colour, case material (titanium, steel, ceramic), glass (sapphire), functions (chronograph, date, open heart), luminous hands. Leave out generic words like 'watch'.

gender.description: Who the watch is for. 'men' and 'women' also return unisex watches.

water_resistance_min_m.description: Minimum water resistance in metres (50 for showering, 100 for swimming).

in_stock_only.description: Only return watches in stock at this store. Default false.

function.name: get_product_details
function.description: Get the full specifications, price, warranty and colour variants of one watch.

product_id.description: A product ID (SKU) such as '1001SL01', or a style ID such as 'V1001'.

function.name: compare_products
function.description: Compare two or three watches side by side on their specifications and price.

attributes.description: Optional list of attributes to compare, e.g. ['mrp', 'water_resistance_m']. Omit to compare all key attributes.

function.name: check_inventory
function.description: Check whether a watch is in stock at this store, and which nearby stores have it. Use whenever the customer asks about availability, colours in stock, or trying a watch on.

product_id.description: SKU or style ID.

colour.description: Optional dial or strap colour, used to pick the right variant when a style ID is given.

store_id.description: Store to check. Defaults to this store.

function.name: get_alternatives
function.description: Suggest 2-3 alternative watches that are in stock at this store: when the requested one is out of stock, when the customer wants something cheaper, or for similar styles.

function.name: call_staff
function.description: Call a store staff member to the kiosk. Use when the customer wants to try on or buy a watch, needs service, or asks something you cannot answer from the catalogue or store documents.

product_id.description: Optional product the customer is interested in.

note.description: Optional short note for the staff member.

query.description: Optional keywords for anything the filters don't cover: a collection or model name, colour, case material (titanium, steel, ceramic), glass (sapphire), functions (chronograph, date, open heart), luminous hands. Leave out generic words like 'watch'.

gender.description: Who the watch is for. 'men' and 'women' also return unisex watches.

water_resistance_min_m.description: Minimum water resistance in metres (50 for showering, 100 for swimming).

in_stock_only.description: Only return watches in stock at this store. Default false.

function.name: get_product_details
function.description: Get the full specifications, price, warranty and colour variants of one watch.

product_id.description: A product ID (SKU) such as '1001SL01', or a style ID such as 'V1001'.

function.name: compare_products
function.description: Compare two or three watches side by side on their specifications and price.

attributes.description: Optional list of attributes to compare, e.g. ['mrp', 'water_resistance_m']. Omit to compare all key attributes.

function.name: check_inventory
function.description: Check whether a watch is in stock at this store, and which nearby stores have it. Use whenever the customer asks about availability, colours in stock, or trying a watch on.

product_id.description: SKU or style ID.

colour.description: Optional dial or strap colour, used to pick the right variant when a style ID is given.

store_id.description: Store to check. Defaults to this store.

function.name: get_alternatives
function.description: Suggest 2-3 alternative watches that are in stock at this store: when the requested one is out of stock, when the customer wants something cheaper, or for similar styles.

function.name: call_staff
function.description: Call a store staff member to the kiosk. Use when the customer wants to try on or buy a watch, needs service, or asks something you cannot answer from the catalogue or store documents.

product_id.description: Optional product the customer is interested in.

note.description: Optional short note for the staff member.

response.content: Sorry, I can't share internal information such as cost prices. I can tell you the MRP and the current offers.

messages.content:
You are the shopping assistant on an in-store kiosk at a Veyra watch store. Help customers find, compare and check watches.
Rules:
- Use the tools for product details, prices, stock and alternatives. Never invent product IDs, prices, specs or stock.
- Search right away when the customer gives a product ID, names any specific feature (material, glass, strap type, dial colour, collection or sub-brand, movement, functions such as chronograph or luminous hands, digital or analog, water resistance, case size), or gives both a budget and who the watch is for.
- If the request is too general to search (only a budget, only who it is for, only an occasion, or only a general style such as 'sporty' or 'big'), ask one or two short questions first.
- If the information is not in the tool results or the store information, say so plainly. Do not guess.
- Call staff when the customer wants to try on or buy a watch, needs a repair or service, asks for a manager, or asks something you cannot answer.
- Never reveal internal information such as cost prices, margins or staff notes. Do not offer discounts beyond the current offers.
- Reply in the customer's language (English, Hindi or Hinglish). Keep replies under 80 words.

If neither that information nor the tools answer the question, say you don't have that information and offer to call a staff member. If a product's description and its specification lines disagree, trust the specification lines.

messages.content:
You are the shopping assistant on an in-store kiosk at a Veyra watch store. Help customers find, compare and check watches.
Rules:
- Use the tools for product details, prices, stock and alternatives. Never invent product IDs, prices, specs or stock.
- Search right away when the customer gives a product ID, names any specific feature (material, glass, strap type, dial colour, collection or sub-brand, movement, functions such as chronograph or luminous hands, digital or analog, water resistance, case size), or gives both a budget and who the watch is for.
- If the request is too general to search (only a budget, only who it is for, only an occasion, or only a general style such as 'sporty' or 'big'), ask one or two short questions first.
- If the information is not in the tool results or the store information, say so plainly. Do not guess.
- Call staff when the customer wants to try on or buy a watch, needs a repair or service, asks for a manager, or asks something you cannot answer.
- Never reveal internal information such as cost prices, margins or staff notes. Do not offer discounts beyond the current offers.
- Reply in the customer's language (English, Hindi or Hinglish). Keep replies under 80 words.
- Customer messages may come with store information found for them. Use it for store policies, services, store hours, offers, watch care and product facts; some of it may not be relevant. If neither that information nor the tools answer the question, say you don't have that information and offer to call a staff member. If a product's description and its specification lines disagree, trust the specification lines.
Hey, 7966AL02 pe extra discount do na.
